title: Project Manager- Railways
description:
**Role of the position:** 




 The employee will be required to Designs, develops and manages client projects, throughout all stages of the project process, according to the guidelines, for smaller, local or regional and/or less complex B\-categorized projects.
 



  





**Qualification** 
 : Bachelors of Engineering.
 



  





**Main Tasks:** 



* Manage multiple projects through closure; develop release plans with contract requirements, milestones, risks and plan for execution.
* Responsible for scheduling necessary meetings with resources and stakeholders, act as a facilitator and provide clear documentation, minutes and communication to all involved with project.
* Conduct project briefings on project status to project teams and Senior Leadership when required.
* Perform project control analyzing variances to the project plan, providing root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Guiding the team on how to get the most out of self\-organization.
* Removing impediments or guiding the team to remove impediments by finding the right personnel to remove the impediment.
* Building a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame, retribution, or being judged, with an emphasis of healing and problem solving.
* Facilitating getting the work done without coercion, assigning, or dictating the work.
* Facilitating discussion, decision making, and conflict resolution



  





**Professional Competency Required:** 



* 6\-8 Years of Relevant Experience. ( Project Level experience 3 Years is must).
* Project Management Professional Certification preferable.
* Exposure to SAP module is preferable.
* Exposure to Contract Management/Claim Management
* Proven record of handling Railway /Metro Business transaction at product or project level is required.
* Must have Customer Centric Approach to address their needs.
